contract: Retain input distribution, generator, samples, quantile levels and report schema. Use standard-library exact-rational sample mean/variance reduction and bounded exact-rational interpolation of sorted binary64 samples at the existing linear quantile levels; reject nonfinite or unrepresentable reported statistics before returning a success-shaped record. Preserve zero variance, subnormal values, signed finite outcomes, and Bessel correction. No sampling distribution or default seed change.
implementation: Replace only outcome summary arithmetic in core/scientific_kernel.py, with a private helper if useful, tests using deterministic callable outputs and independently computed rational/Decimal oracles, and one retained bounded report fixture. No physics/model change, external challenges, protected labels or old result regeneration.
falsifier: For accepted deterministic finite outcomes, summary mean/std/SE/quantiles disagree with independent high-precision sample statistics beyond binary64 rounding tolerance, or an unrepresentable statistic returns infinity/NaN as a valid report.
qualification: Arithmetic correctness under a caller-specified normal input remains distinct from empirical validation, manufacturability or safety. Existing partial evidence and falsified typed-parser claim remain unchanged.
